name: Kid-safe social network with bot workshop

mentions.name: Kid-safe social network with bot workshop
mentions.description: A social platform that lets kids chat and play online with other kids in a parent-connected network. Parents sign up and connect with the parents of their children's friends before kids can connect, and kids can also chat with their parents and family. Messages can be monitored by parents. Activities include a bot workshop where kids "program" simple LLM bots by writing system prompts (video game helper bots, ice cream shop bots, adventure/Dungeons & Dragons-style bots), a sticker book with cartoon image search, and a quiz creator, with more planned. The guiding principles are to create a fun, positive, safe space for kids and families to socialize and to empower kids to explore technology as a creative tool rather than just consume content.
mentions.problem: Kids lack a fun, positive, safe online space to socialize and interact with friends and family, and to explore and understand technology as a creative tool rather than just consuming content.
mentions.audience: Kids and their families; parents sign up and connect with other parents so their kids can chat and play with friends in their network.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am working on a site that allows kids to chat and play online with other kids.  To connect, kids must have their parents sign up and connect with the parents of their friends.  Kids can chat with their parents and family as well as other kids in their network.  Messages can be monitored by parents.  There are also other activities like a bot workshop where simple llm bots can be "programmed" by creating system prompts (kids create video game helper bots, ice cream shop bots,   adventure/dungeons and dragons style bots, etc).  There is a sticker book (cartoon image search), and a quiz creator.  Many other things are planned!
